outcome.implementation_change: The existing denial-to-preflight projection now exposes the completeness boundary of its same-claim search. It distinguishes a returned exact match, no same-claim match in complete returned overlap evidence, an unobserved match under truncated overlaps, and incomplete preflight-record windows.

outcome.analysis_limit: The change preserves uncertainty in bounded historical evidence. It does not add missing overlap identities, show that a later preflight caused the original denial to be resolved, or demonstrate a successful Git operation.
